svg.title: Option A — push timeout, SMS failover and late receipts

g.text: Option A — push timeout, SMS failover and late receipts
PUSH attempt accepted at t0; no app receipt.
At deadline: lock notification; check receipt/state/version
Claim; final pre-send check; durable DISPATCHING
Send via SMS-B with its own attempt_id
No blind retry with a new key.
Same-provider resend only with contractual idempotency.
cancel only attempts not yet dispatched
Receipt racing with a timer is serialized by CAS.
An already-sent SMS cannot be recalled.
Late cross-channel duplicates remain possible and are measured.
At t0+60s without proof: record SLO breach; continue recovery
At 24h unresolved: ESCALATED + incident; no silent drop
